test_title: PYST 63: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that does NOT have a spelling error.

options.text: The new caches of materials reveal a secret pleasence that was hidden away from the rest of the world
Statistical patterns and historical data cannot predict the futristic problems that await a civilisation like ours.
Many friends and memoirists have described the author in detail but there are no photos of the author available to the press.
The author is famous for leading a life of subterfuge and contredictions which has led to challenges in understanding past works.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Option 3 is correct because it does **not contain any spelling error.**

__
 
• The sentence is: **“Many friends and memoirists have described the author in detail but there are no photos of the author available to the press.”**
 
• All words such as **friends, memoirists, described, available, press** are correctly spelled.

Therefore, the sentence without any spelling error is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: “pleasence” → correct spelling: pleasantness or pleasance
 
• Option 2: “futristic” → correct spelling: futuristic; “civilisation” is also non-standard in American English (British spelling: civilisation)
 
• Option 4: “contredictions” → correct spelling: contradictions
